title: Voltas Beko 436L Side by Side Refrigerator
description: This side-by-side refrigerator has a net capacity of 436L and a gross capacity of 472L. It includes 6-in-1 adjustable modes, a ProSmart inverter compressor and dual LED illumination.

highlights.title: 6-in-1 Adjustable
highlights.subtitle: Adjust between modes effortlessly to suit your needs

highlights.title: ProSmart Inverter Compressor
highlights.subtitle: Energy efficient, quiet, and built to last

highlights.title: LED Lighting
highlights.subtitle: Provides better lighting inside the fridge
